title: Joonee Gamboa is back to tell spine-chilling Pinoy ghost stories in "Philippines' Most Haunted"
excerpt: Ready for Halloween chills? 👻 Joonee Gamboa hosts ABS-CBN News’ newest series “Philippines’ Most Haunted” starting Oct 15. Expect real ghost encounters and Pinoy folklore. Here’s what to expect 👇 #…
content:
QUEZON CITY, Philippines (Oct 2026): An abandoned mansion in Northwestern Luzon and eerie accounts of lingering spirits set the stage for “Philippines’ Most Haunted,” the newest digital horror documentary series from ABS-CBN News.

Hosted by veteran actor Joonee Gamboa, the weekly series explores creepy firsthand testimonies, local folklore, and paranormal investigations across the country. The show begins streaming on October 15, 2026, at 8 PM on the ABS-CBN News YouTube channel and iWant.

Uncovering spooky tales across the country

In its premiere episode, Joonee Gamboa takes viewers inside a haunted mansion where a former resident family reported feeling the presence of an old lady and a young child. A paranormal expert joins the investigation to communicate with the spirits left behind on the property. Guided by Gamboa’s commanding voice and storytelling presence, the show uncovers why these supernatural encounters continue to frighten Pinoy audiences.

More horror lineups for Halloween

“Philippines’ Most Haunted” adds to a growing slate of digital shows from ABS-CBN News, which includes titles such as “Philippines’ Most Shocking Stories,” “Philippines’ Oddest Jobs,” and “Oh My Gan!”.

For horror fans looking for extra chills this Halloween season, the ABS-CBN News YouTube channel also features John Arcilla hosting “Possessed: Real Stories from Filipino Exorcists,” along with “Philippines’ Strangest Mysteries,” classic “Magandang Gabi… Bayan” horror features, and Noli de Castro’s “Kababalaghan” specials on demand.

Where to watch

New episodes of “Philippines’ Most Haunted” stream every Thursday at 8 PM starting October 15 on the ABS-CBN News YouTube channel and iWant.
